scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: Good morning! Milk, bread with jam, one banana… breakfast makes explorers strong!
scene.intro: Good morning! Freya has milk and bread with jam for breakfast, and one banana to take to school. Astrid has an egg and a glass of juice. The spoon falls, the milk goes on the table, and everybody laughs. Breakfast makes the day happy — and long, if you eat slowly like Freya. What do YOU have for breakfast? Sit down with them and say it in English!
